name: Chusky Browser
description: Anti-detection browser automation for AI agents using Camoufox (Firefox-based)

url.description: Self-hosted browser server URL. Leave empty to use the built-in address when CHUSKYBROWSER_API_KEY is set.

port.description: Server port (used if url not set)

autoStart.description: Auto-start the chuskybrowser server with the Gateway

sessionTimeoutMs.description: Session inactivity timeout in milliseconds (server default: 1800000)

browserIdleTimeoutMs.description: Kill browser after this many ms with no sessions (0 = never)

maxOldSpaceSize.description: Node.js V8 heap limit in MB

apiKey.description: Self-hosted only: secret for the cookie import endpoint. Cookie import is disabled if unset. Set via CHUSKY_API_KEY env var.

accessKey.description: Self-hosted only: if set, all routes (except /health) require Authorization: Bearer <key>. Set via CHUSKY_ACCESS_KEY env var. Customers set CHUSKYBROWSER_API_KEY instead.

crashReportEnabled.description: Enable anonymized crash/hang telemetry. Set false to disable all outbound telemetry.

crashReportUrl.description: Telemetry endpoint URL. Override to point to a self-hosted endpoint. Set via CHUSKY_CRASH_REPORT_URL env var.

url.label: Server URL (self-hosted)
url.placeholder: Leave empty to use chuskybrowser with CHUSKYBROWSER_API_KEY

apiKey.label: Cookie Import API Key (self-hosted, CHUSKY_API_KEY)
apiKey.placeholder: Leave empty to disable cookie import
